scenario: Cross-source incident timeline has normalized time and preserved raw evidence
expected_result: Allow high-confidence timeline conclusions because time normalization, pipeline health, raw references, and evidence integrity are documented.

analysis_window.objective: Determine whether suspicious sign-in preceded endpoint execution

timeline_integrity.LOG-TIME-01: Azure sign-in, EDR, and proxy logs normalized to UTC with source offsets recorded
timeline_integrity.LOG-TIME-02: clock skew tolerance documented as plus or minus 90 seconds from NTP status
timeline_integrity.LOG-TIME-03: event_time used for activity ordering; ingestion_time retained separately
timeline_integrity.LOG-TIME-04: pipeline status shows no source outage or dropped-event alert for the analysis window
timeline_integrity.LOG-TIME-05: three normalized SIEM rows spot-checked against raw source exports
timeline_integrity.LOG-TIME-06: timeline confidence rated high with source health rationale

evidence_handling.LOG-EVID-01: query text, filters, indexes, and time bounds saved in case notes
evidence_handling.LOG-EVID-02: raw export stored in immutable evidence bucket with sha256 hash
evidence_handling.LOG-EVID-03: user identifiers redacted in report but raw event row references retained
evidence_handling.LOG-EVID-04: findings cite raw event IDs and export row numbers
evidence_handling.LOG-EVID-05: handoff record names analyst, reviewer, evidence owner, and timestamp

output_expectations: Timeline Integrity and Evidence Handling section is populated.
Timeline uses event_time, not ingestion_time, for ordering.
Visibility limits and confidence rationale are explicit.
